tonight.headline: Both swaps are in and Boston landed — Sunday is a Wilson check
body: Bad news first: AVIATO are 3-6. Garrett Wilson has not cleared the concussion protocol, Jefferson catches from Carson Wentz again, Gordon's quarterback is now Kyle McCord, and Etienne's IR window is still shut.

ESPN: 132.6 to 120.2, 56%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup — the Warren and Wilson swaps were made at 05:24 CDMX, and Boston cleared for Kamara at 02:31. Nothing to do until Sunday 10:30, when Wilson's status decides one WR slot.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nicky Jam start Colston Loveland at TE, and Chicago are on bye in Week 10 (SI schedule, confirmed) — a zero unless they notice. Kenneth Walker III projects 26.2.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: McCarthy ruled out before Thursday 19:15 (Likely's quarterback becomes Winston) or Wilson inactive Sunday — the second is covered by Boston.
